newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson stake held by FMR group.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson stake held by FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing Thursday it holds a 10.37 percent stake in Hutchinson Technology Inc or 565,000 common shares.

The group disclosed its latest position on Technology in a 13G filing. Those filings are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. Unlike 13D filings, they do not list latest transactions.
FMR Corp is the parent of the investment adviser to Fidelity Funds. Hutchinson Technology, of Hutchinson, Minn., is a supplier of suspension assemblies for rigid disk drives.
